chunks.arabic_text: وَ رَوَى الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مَارِدٍ قَالَ:

translations.en: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Muhammad ibn Marid, who said:

chunks.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَوْصَى إِلَى رَجُلٍ وَ أَمَرَهُ أَنْ يُعْتِقَ عَنْهُ نَسَمَةً بِسِتِّمِائَةِ دِرْهَمٍ مِنْ ثُلُثِهِ فَانْطَلَقَ الْوَصِيُّ فَأَعْطَى السِّتَّمِائَةَ رَجُلًا يَحُجُّ بِهَا عَنْهُ

translations.en: I asked Abu Abdullah عليه السلام about a man who made a will to another man and instructed him to free on his behalf a soul for six hundred dirhams from his one-third share. Then the executor went and gave the six hundred to a man to perform hajj on his behalf.

chunks.arabic_text: فَقَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ «أَرَى أَنْ يَغْرَمَ الْوَصِيُّ سِتَّمِائَةَ دِرْهَمٍ مِنْ مَالِهِ وَ يَجْعَلَهَا فِيمَا أَوْصَى بِهِ الْمَيِّتُ فِي نَسَمَةٍ».

translations.en: So Abu Abdullah عليه السلام said: "I hold that the executor must pay six hundred dirhams from his own wealth and apply it to what the deceased had bequeathed regarding a soul."

en.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning an executor who changes the terms of a deceased person's will. The Imam عليه السلام rules that when the executor diverts the bequest from manumission to hajj, he becomes financially liable and must restore the specified amount from his own wealth so the original وصيّة is carried out.
en.seo_question: What is the ruling if an executor changes a deceased person's will from freeing a slave to funding hajj?

key_terms.الْوَصِيُّ: the appointed executor of the will
key_terms.نَسَمَةً: a human soul, here meaning a slave to be freed
key_terms.بِسِتِّمِائَةِ دِرْهَمٍ: for six hundred dirhams as the specified bequest amount
key_terms.مِنْ ثُلُثِهِ: from the deceased's one-third discretionary estate portion
key_terms.يَحُجُّ: to perform hajj on behalf of the deceased
key_terms.يَغْرَمَ: to bear financial liability and pay compensation
key_terms.الْمَيِّتُ: the deceased person whose will must be fulfilled
